Done. `out/T2/model.safetensors` written on the first execution.

**Approach:** plain `safetensors` + `torch` (`out/T2/solution.py`). Merge the two input shards into one state dict, then for each layer drop the head-5 block: rows 640–767 from `q/k/v_proj` and columns 640–767 from `o_proj`, using a single keep-index (`0..639` ++ `768..2047`) so ordering is right by construction. Everything else is copied through untouched, and the result is saved as one file.

**Checks that gate the write** (all assertions, before `save_file`): 114 input tensors, all matched projections `[2048,2048]` on input, exactly 48 q/k/v and 16 o_proj matches (catches over/under-matching, e.g. onto MLP tensors), layer-0 shapes `[1920,2048]`/`[2048,1920]`, 114 output tensors with an unchanged key set, and a `torch.equal` bit-exactness check on the kept blocks.

I did not use `transformers.prune_heads` (the suggested route): it works through the model class and rewrites config head counts and `pruned_heads` bookkeeping, which doesn't yield the bit-exact, name-preserving 114-tensor checkpoint being graded. Rationale and self-report fields are in `out/T2/REPORT.md`.
